issue.title: Stabilize artifact-file facade tests under full-suite load
issue.description: During required verification for the code-swap guard work on 2026-08-02, full 'just check' passed all lint and validation stages, then failed pytest with exactly two artifact-file facade nodes after 25,535 passes / 7 skips: tests/artifact_file_facade/test_reclaim.py::test_clean_pushed_file_reclaims_resolves_and_is_idempotent and tests/artifact_file_facade/test_vcs.py::test_materialize_artifact_file_uses_verified_content_cache. Both nodes passed immediately afterward when rerun directly with '.venv/bin/python -m pytest <two nodes> -q' (2 passed in 1.98s), so this appears to be xdist/full-suite load or order sensitivity rather than a deterministic regression in the code-swap lock changes. Reproduce under full-suite or targeted parallel load, identify the shared artifact-file cache/reclaim state leak or timing dependency, and make the tests deterministic without weakening their VCS cache/reclaim guarantees.
